claims: The last human moon launch was NASA's Apollo 17 mission.
NASA's Apollo 17 mission launched on December 7, 1972.
Astronauts Eugene Cernan and Harrison Schmitt landed in the Taurus-Littrow valley.
Eugene Cernan and Harrison Schmitt spent three days on the lunar surface.
Eugene Cernan and Harrison Schmitt departed the lunar surface on December 14, 1972.
Eugene Cernan was the last human to walk on the moon.
Eugene Cernan was the Commander of NASA's Apollo 17 mission.
Harrison Schmitt was the Lunar Module Pilot of NASA's Apollo 17 mission.
Ronald Evans was the Command Module Pilot of NASA's Apollo 17 mission.
NASA's Apollo 17 mission was the final mission of the Apollo program.
NASA's Apollo 17 mission featured the longest moonwalks.
NASA's Apollo 17 mission featured the largest sample collection.
Robotic missions have landed on the moon since 1972.
China's Chang'e series have landed on the moon since 1972.
The NASA Artemis II mission is set for 2026.
The NASA Artemis II mission marks the first crewed mission back to the moon in over 50 years.
